entries.title: Create safe backyard equipment access
entries.detail: A direct temporary ramp from the driveway drop-off would require an impractically long run at a safe grade. Measure the site and target equipment before comparing alternatives.

entries.title: Measure the backyard access route
entries.detail: Record vertical drop, available run, staging and landing area, path width, gate clearance, and turns; photograph the route before foliage changes.

entries.title: Define the target equipment envelope
entries.detail: Record target equipment width, weight, turning radius, and acceptable operating grade.

entries.title: Compare safe access concepts
entries.detail: Blocked until the route and equipment envelope are measured; compare alternate alignments and equipment-specific access rather than assuming one long ramp.

entries.title: Prepare the fall leaf workflow
entries.detail: Stage tools and materials before leaf drop; solo removal becomes rain-sensitive within roughly a two-week collection window.
